messages:
tom: Heads up everyone — we shipped redwood-llm-ops-plugins v0.3.0 to GitHub and PyPI. Small release but a bunch of quality-of-life fixes. :shipit:

release-bot: Release published: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-llm-ops-plugins/releases/tag/v0.3.0 

anika: Summary for the community post: new plugin hooks for pre- and post-token transforms, simpler auth for private registries, and a compat shim for older runtimes.

lee: Nice. Any regressions to watch for?

tom: Two things to call out: 1) plugin authors using the older middleware API need to switch to the new hook names (migration notes in the release). 2) If you use the built-in registry auth, you'll want to rotate tokens after upgrading (we tightened validation).

ops-bot: Deploy checklist: docs updated, integration tests green, nightly job scheduled to exercise plugin loader.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed for v0.3.0 (build 7248). Integration tests: plugin-loader, auth, transform-hooks 60 passed.

anika: Community event idea: quick livestream demo next Tuesday where maintainers show how to write a simple transform plugin and troubleshoot common errors. Want volunteers?

lee: I'll demo the auth workflow. Tom can you do the transform example?

tom: Yep, happy to. Can someone create a short slide deck (3-4 slides) and we'll do a 20-25min session.

anika: I'll draft the agenda + event post. Also looking for volunteers to translate the basic README into Spanish and Japanese. @translations-bot can you notify volunteers?

translations-bot: Translation request posted in #community-international: 2 short README files (installation, examples) 10-15 minute work each.

lee: For the release blurb: we measured ~12% median improvement in plugin loading time with the shim disabled on small containers. Is it okay to include that in the public post?

tom: Yes, include the perf stat with a note: measured on small (2vCPU) containers, non-quantized models.

anika: Draft blurb for forum/Twitter (copyable): "redwood-llm-ops-plugins v0.3.0 — faster plugin loads, new transform hooks, easier registry auth. Check release notes for migration steps and join our maintainer livestream next Tue."

ops-bot: Security note: minor hardening added around token validation. No CVE needed but security team has been notified.

ci-bot: Artifact locations: sdist, wheel on PyPI; docker test images pushed to ghcr.io/redwood-inference/redwood-llm-ops-plugins:0.3.0

lee: Small docs request: add a 'troubleshooting' subsection with common import errors. Can someone toss a short example?

tom: Example snippet posted in the release notes under troubleshooting: small code block showing plugin registration and a try/except with clear error messages.

anika: Great. I'll coordinate the social post after Tom + Lee review the draft. Thanks all. If anyone wants to join the livestream rehearsal, ping me and I'll add you to the invite.

lee: RSVP'd for the rehearsal. :thumbsup:

tom: Thanks team — nice incremental release. :tada:"
